error.transferDone: The transfer is done. Your ICP is in the neuron sub-account, not lost. Try again to claim the neuron. The app makes no second transfer.

infoBoxes.whatIsStaking: Locking your ICP creates a neuron that mints voting rewards. You can mint up to ~{{maxApy}} maturity depending on your lock period and participation.
infoBoxes.dissolveDelayWarning: The lock period can only be increased, never decreased. The countdown only begins when you start unlocking.
infoBoxes.lockedDescription: Locked: neuron stays locked, minting maximum rewards. Start unlocking later when you want to withdraw.
infoBoxes.unlockingDescription: Unlocking: countdown begins immediately. After the lock period, you can withdraw your ICP.

errors.cannotStake: You need ICP to lock. Please buy or deposit ICP first.

confirmNavigation: Your neuron is being created, leaving this page may cause unexpected results. Are you sure you want to leave?
confirmNavigationUnsaved: Your progress will not be saved. Are you sure you want to leave?

approvalPurposes.transfer: Moves the ICP to the neuron.
approvalPurposes.hotkey: Lets this app show and vote with the neuron.
approvalPurposes.dissolveDelay: Sets the lock period of the neuron.
approvalPurposes.autoStake: Locks the rewards into the neuron.
approvalPurposes.startDissolving: Starts the unlocking of the neuron.

approve.transfer: Check the amount on the device screen and approve the transfer.
approve.hotkey: Check the hotkey principal on the device screen and approve.
approve.dissolveDelay: Approve the lock period on the device screen. The device shows the time to add.
approve.autoStake: Approve the auto-lock of rewards on the device screen.
approve.startDissolving: Approve the start of the unlocking on the device screen.

ledgerDevice.recovered: An earlier stake of {{amount}} ICP from a Ledger device account is claimed. Open the device account and add this app as hotkey to see the neuron.
